Definition: Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Zalmon = "shady"; n pr m; 1) an Ahohite, one of David's mighty warriors; n pr loc; 2) a wooded hill in Samaria near Shechem
